name: Speed Queen® Commercial 7 Cu. Ft. White Vented Gas Dryer
shortDescription: With an easy-to-clean large lint compartment and a reversible door to accommodate your laundry design, Speed Queen® single dryers are designed to suit your laundry’s specific needs. The 2.06 sq. ft. door opening is the largest in the industry, providing easy loading and unloading.

features.text: Efficient dryer heating with 22,500 Btu (gas models) and 5350 Watts (electric models)
Durable galvanized steel cylinder with an extra-large 7 cu. ft. of volume

Speed Queen® dryers with Electronic Homestyle controls are designed for durability and are easy to operate with intuitive selection buttons and cycle status indicator lights. This control option features a time-remaining display, six preset cycle buttons, cycle adjustability for temperature and load size.
